Entry The Citadel and Skepticism of Magic The Citadel values ​​observation, recording, and impartable knowledge, and is often skeptical of prophecies, miracles, and magic. The caution of bachelors can prevent ignorance from spreading, and may also cause them to underestimate things that cannot be immediately explained; reason is not without blind spots, but is willing to admit blind spots. Altars, relics, and prophecies can unite people and give a political claim the appearance of irrefutability.
